Feature: Login Functionality

Scenario Outline: Successful Login for Doctor, Chemist, and Lab

  Given the system has been set up by an Admin with default passwords for Doctor, Chemist, and Lab
  When a user with valid credentials logs in
  Then they should be granted access to their respective area

Examples:
  | User Type | Password | Expected Access |
  | Doctor    | Default  | Doctor's Area   |
  | Chemist   | Default  | Chemist's Area  |
  | Lab      | Default  | Lab's Area     |

Scenario Outline: Unsuccessful Login due to Incorrect Password

  Given the system has been set up by an Admin with default passwords for Doctor, Chemist, and Lab
  When a user with incorrect credentials logs in
  Then they should be denied access

Examples:
  | User Type | Password | Expected Access |
  | Doctor    | Wrong    | Denied Access   |
  | Chemist   | Wrong    | Denied Access   |
  | Lab      | Wrong    | Denied Access   |

Scenario Outline: Unsuccessful Login due to Non-Existent User

  Given the system has been set up by an Admin with default passwords for Doctor, Chemist, and Lab
  When a non-existent user attempts to log in
  Then they should be denied access

Examples:
  | User Type | Password | Expected Access |
  | Doctor    | Default  | Denied Access   |
  | Chemist   | Default  | Denied Access   |
  | Lab      | Default  | Denied Access   |

Scenario Outline: Login with Expired Password

  Given the system has been set up by an Admin with default passwords for Doctor, Chemist, and Lab
  When a user with an expired password attempts to log in
  Then they should be denied access

Examples:
  | User Type | Password | Expected Access |
  | Doctor    | Expired   | Denied Access   |
  | Chemist   | Expired   | Denied Access   |
  | Lab      | Expired   | Denied Access   |

Scenario Outline: Login with Multiple Attempts

  Given the system has been set up by an Admin with default passwords for Doctor, Chemist, and Lab
  When a user with valid credentials attempts to log in multiple times
  Then they should be granted access after a certain number of attempts

Examples:
  | User Type | Password | Expected Access |
  | Doctor    | Default  | Access after 3 |
  | Chemist   | Default  | Access after 3 |
  | Lab      | Default  | Access after 3 |

Scenario Outline: Login with Account Locked

  Given the system has been set up by an Admin with default passwords for Doctor, Chemist, and Lab
  When a user with valid credentials attempts to log in after their account has been locked
  Then they should be denied access

Examples:
  | User Type | Password | Expected Access |
  | Doctor    | Default  | Denied Access   |
  | Chemist   | Default  | Denied Access   |
  | Lab      | Default  | Denied Access   |
